title: Phenomenon Name
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the phenomenon as optical activity.

title: Explanation of Rotation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear explanation of how the rotation of the plane of polarization occurs due to the differing indices of refraction.

title: Derivation of Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the angle of rotation phi.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly write the final formula for phi, including the factors of 1/2 and the difference between n_R and n_L.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units in the derived expression are consistent and correct.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression.
